title: Dependency Audit
description: Review dependencies and imports in the selected files for risk, bloat, and supply-chain exposure.
prompt: Audit the dependencies and imports used in the selected files. For each notable dependency, note: what it is used for here, whether it is actually needed or could be replaced with the standard library, any maintenance or supply-chain risk signals you can infer from the code, and whether it pulls in network or filesystem access. Flag anything that conflicts with a zero-dependency, local-first goal. End with a short ranked list of dependencies to remove, replace, or pin. Do not invent version numbers or CVEs you cannot see.
